concept.title: Product definition
concept.shortdesc: Three fields, editable in place with Edit; beside it is the way into the guided definition (labeled Start, Resume or Modify guided definition depending on where the project is):

ul.li: Vision — what the world looks like once this product succeeds.
Problem statement — what problem, for whom, and why now.
Target users — the primary users and buyers.

conbody.p: Step 1 of the guided wizard reads and writes the same fields, so the wizard and the overview always agree.
